description: Cumulative incidence of pericardial effusion (Kaplan-Meier-style step curves), two series told apart by shade: black (mean pericardium dose > 20.33 Gy) and grey (<= 20.33 Gy). Journal figure (Pao et al. 2020, Radiat Oncol 15:48, Fig. 1 panel c; crop x 0-710, y 740-1431 of the publisher's 1418x1431 PNG), 710x691 greyscale PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: Black 2-px axis line (rows 485-486, columns 112-674) with solid 5-px tick marks below it (rows 488-492) at every label; labels 0, 24, 48, 72 centred within 0.6 px of the marks. x = 0 is 25 px right of the y axis line (ggplot expansion): the axis lines are not the zero lines.

yAxis.notes: Black 2-px axis line (columns 112-113, rows 35-486) with solid 6-px tick marks left of it (columns 106-111) at every label; labels formatted 0.00-1.00. y = 0 sits 21 px above the x axis line.

knownValues.description: Curve sits on y = 0 before its first step (columns 139-177); y = 0 is above the x axis line

pitfalls: The axis lines are not the zero lines: x = 0 is at column 138, 25 px right of the y axis, and y = 0 at row 465, 21 px above the x axis (ggplot-style expansion with theme_classic axes).

Rotated y-axis title at columns ~3-30 and the x-axis title at rows ~535-565; a 'Number at risk' table (86 12 6 0 / 40 15 8 5) with legend-style black and grey bars sits below the axis title (rows ~592-688) - not tick labels.
Legend inside the plot (rows 62-66 black sample, 89-93 grey sample, text to the right) and 'p = 0.00027' are not data.
The black series is a dense staircase of ~30 small steps between 0 and 11 months (5-px line); the grey series (grey ~162) is drawn under the black one where they cross near the origin.
No censoring marks on either curve.
